overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Medford resident Robert Carney about his experiences with civic engagement, municipal trash policy, local political organizing, school facilities planning, and rent control.

items.title: Introduction and Background of Robert Carney
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced local resident Robert Carney, who shared details about his background, career, and move to South Medford.

items.title: Homeowners Association Trash Dispute
items.summary: Carney described how a letter from the Department of Public Works terminating free trash pickup for his townhouse community motivated him to organize neighbors, petition city officials, and attend City Council meetings.

items.title: Value of Resident Civic Engagement
items.summary: Carney discussed why resident involvement is crucial to hold elected officials accountable and offered advice on how citizens can participate even with limited time.

items.title: City Council Responsiveness and Our Revolution Medford
items.summary: Carney shared mixed experiences with City Council responsiveness and expressed concerns that the local progressive political group, Our Revolution Medford, enforces a rigid platform that limits open dialogue and diversity on the council.

items.title: Medford High School Rebuild Project
items.summary: Carney criticized the Medford High School rebuild process as rushed, raising concerns about land-use diligence, rising construction costs, student population projections, and a lack of preventative maintenance.

items.title: Rent Control Ballot Initiative
items.summary: Carney explained his opposition to a proposed rent control ballot initiative, arguing that capping rent increases would squeeze middle-class landlords facing rising expenses and disincentivize housing development and maintenance.

items.title: Program Outro and Civic Access Information
items.summary: Petrella concluded the episode by thanking Carney, explaining how residents can request to appear on the show, and detailing how to access program replays and podcasts.
